headline: As Financial Stress Weighs on Workers, Gallagher Introduces a Platform Focused on Better Financial Decision-Making
summary: Today Gallagher launched Gallagher Guide's Financial Wellbeing platform, a personalized digital tool for US employers and their employees. The tool is designed to help employees make more informed financial decisions, improve financial confidence and support long-term financial resilience. It combines educational resources, digital tools and access to financial coaches and wealth managers to support employees through key financial decisions throughout their lives.
